versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> call is returned unchanged from the Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback.

When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData call is returned unchanged from the Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData callback.

When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData call is returned unchanged from the Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData callback.
